name: dGPU Control
author: rawritude
description: Control the discrete GPU on a dual-GPU machine: block it entirely, allow it per-application, or leave it to park itself — and see exactly which processes are keeping it awake. Reads never wake the card. Optional ASUS ROG/TUF power profile and firmware limits when asusd is present. Requires the cardwire daemon and Wayland.

barWidget.description: Block, allow or park the discrete GPU, see its real power state, and find what is holding it awake.
